description.p: Make music with this simple, easy to use, and addictive little app. Technically a step sequencers, MusicGrid was inspired by the funky Tenori-on and the great online ToneMatrix. It has been reviewed on television and downloaded by 1000s of people. Check out the below user generated videos for more information!

This framework is able to display lists of specific locations, be it restaurant chains, coffee shops, offices, or anything else! These locations are stored in a local database, so no Internet connection is needed.
The framework supports the following features:

ul.li: Self contained database of locations.
Sort locations by names or distance.
Display the 10 nearest locations in a list or on a map.
Display detailed information on a single location, i.e. Full Address, Phone Number.
Add the location to the phone’s address book.
Get directions to a specific location.

description.p: So far this framework is used by one application, Nando’s Finder. If you are interested in using this framework or have suggestions on what other apps I could make then please contact me.

description.p: This unoffical fan made application contains a database of every Nando’s in the UK, and allows you to easily find the closest one.
Track the score of any number of players with this simple to use application. Great for card and board games such as Scrabble, Magic, Carcassonne, etc.

ul.li: Unlimited players.
Easy to use.
Assign colours to players.
Randomise order or colours.
Keeps players and scores.
Free!

description.p: If you love or hate this app, or have any suggestions then feel free to contact me.
